page.notes: Corrected spelling: vniuersa read as universa under the u/v rule, and long s throughout. The line-end "de-" before "Ioanna" in the italic paragraph is printed with a dash; I kept it as "de-Ioanna" and it may be a justification dash rather than a true hyphen. Heading "vindicata ." keeps the stray space before the full stop as printed. Page-top stray marks at the left edge and the bottom edge are scan artefacts and were left out.
